name: Kubernetes resource check
description: Compare Kubernetes container resource requests and limits with an Excel baseline

sheet.description: Excel worksheet containing the resource matrix

header_row.description: One-based Excel row containing component names

attribute_column.description: Excel column containing resource attribute names

service_start_column.description: First Excel column containing per-component resource values

mapping_file.description: Optional JSON mapping from Excel components to workload and container names

cpu_default_unit.description: Unit applied to bare CPU values in Excel

memory_default_unit.description: Unit applied to bare memory values in Excel

extra_policy.description: How to handle deployed resources absent from Excel: fail, warn or ignore

ignore_extra.description: Optional comma or space separated glob patterns for extra resource paths

show_pass.description: Print every matching resource instead of only differences
